extDescription.message: Make ChatGPT wider: conversation, prompt, text, code and tables.

presetsLabel.description: Accessible name for the preset group.

presetPresentation.description: Presentation preset button. Press again to leave it.

presetCustom.description: Shown when the current values do not match a preset.

pageMissing.message: The layout could not find this page
pageMissing.description: Shown when the ChatGPT layout anchors are missing.

composerMinHeight.description: Minimum composer height. Zero keeps the native height.

composerMaxHeight.description: Maximum composer height before it scrolls.

composerNative.description: Restore the composer height without changing other settings.

heightNative.description: Shown when a height control is left to the page.

breakout.description: Allow code, tables and images to escape the reading column.

lineHeight.description: Line height slider. Stored as tenths.

fontReadable.description: System sans font with open letterforms.

focusLatest.description: Fade older messages by DOM position.

codeMaxHeight.description: Maximum height of a code block. Zero means no cap.

codeMaxAuto.description: Label when the code block has no height cap.

codeWrap.description: Wrap long code lines instead of scrolling sideways.

sidebarAdjust.description: Apply the sidebar width. Off leaves the page sidebar alone.

presetNamePlaceholder.description: Placeholder for a saved preset name.

saveNamed.description: Save the current layout under a name.

deleteNamed.description: Accessible name for deleting a saved preset.

exportNamed.description: Download the saved layouts as JSON.

importNamed.description: Load saved layouts from a JSON file.

namedFull.description: Shown when a fifth named preset would be added.

namedInvalid.description: Shown when a name or import file is rejected.

statusSaving.description: Status while a write is in flight.

statusError.description: Status when storage rejects the write.

statusStorage.description: Status when chrome.storage cannot be read.
